versions.text: Criterion: Verify that ground operation characteristics are safe. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within the following ADS-33-PRF paragraphs: a. 3.9.1 Rotor start/stop. b. 3.9.2 Parked position requirement. c. 3.9.3 Wheeled rotorcraft ground requirements. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, requirements, design, test, and configuration documentation.
